mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, config_value, description, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, config_key, config_value, description, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_config WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_key, config_value, description) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET config_value = #{configValue} WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 0
